unlisted_practices: Decompose instructional workflows into discrete steps with clearly specified cognitive and technical requirements before assigning tasks to specialized AI agents.
Standardize input and output schemas between AI agents with simple templates to ensure minimum quality standards.
Define clear acceptance criteria for fallback or rollback when an agent step underperforms, allowing repair or educator-initiated rewrites without restarting the pipeline.
Assign each subtask to the foundation model best suited to its cognitive demands.

screen.reason: This is a Viewpoint paper proposing a conceptual framework and architectural paradigm (modular multistep AI agents with human-in-the-loop oversight) for medical education rather than an empirical evaluation.
